def generate_stndrn_variable_set(sigmas):
    """ Generate a set of independent standard normal random variables with specified standard deviations.

    Parameters
    ----------
        sigmas : list or array_like
            Standard deviations for the independent standard normal random variables.

    Returns
    -------
        Q : VariableSet
            A set of independent standard normal random variables with specified standard deviations.
    """
    Q = VariableSet()
    for i in range(len(sigmas)):
        s = Variable('pn_' + str(i+1), NormalDistribution(0, sigmas[i]))
        Q.add(s)
    return Q
